definitions.explanation: Confections that are baked in an oven, such as cookies, cakes, madeleines, and similar items. Contrasts with {生菓子|なまがし} (fresh confections) which are not baked or have a short shelf life.

examples.japanese: {焼|や}き{菓子|がし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{焼|や}いた→焼く：01123_yaku⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{手作|てづく}り→手作り：08300_tezukuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{焼|や}き{菓子|がし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧だ。
examples.english: This shop is famous for its handmade baked goods.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{土産|みやげ}→お土産：01353_omiyage⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{焼|や}き{菓子|がし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{詰|つ}め{合|あ}わせ→詰め合わせ：14175_tsumeawase⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}って→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦{帰|かえ}った→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: I bought an assortment of baked sweets as a souvenir to bring home.

notes:
USAGE:
{焼|や}き{菓子|がし} is a broad term covering Western-style baked goods like cookies, cakes, and tarts, as well as Japanese baked confections. It is a compound of ⟦{焼|や}き→焼く：01123_yaku⟧ (baking) + ⟦{菓子|かし}→菓子：00191_kashi⟧ (sweets), with ⟦{菓子|かし}→菓子：00191_kashi⟧ becoming がし through rendaku.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {焼|や}き{菓子|がし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{詰|つ}め{合|あ}わせ→詰め合わせ：14175_tsumeawase⟧ (assortment of baked goods)
- ⟦{手作|てづく}り→手作り：08300_tezukuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{焼|や}き{菓子|がし} (handmade baked goods)
- {焼|や}き{菓子|がし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{焼|や}く→焼く：01123_yaku⟧ (bake sweets)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{生菓子|なまがし}→生菓子：27039_namagashi⟧ refers to fresh confections that are not baked, such as mochi or fresh wagashi.
- ⟦{和菓子|わがし}→和菓子：04962_wagashi⟧ is the general term for Japanese-style sweets.
- ⟦{洋菓子|ようがし}→洋菓子：04998_yougashi⟧ refers to Western-style confections.
